purpose: Make natural-run liveness durable with one GitHub mutation and zero prerequisite reads, so short scheduler runtime cannot prevent persistence before optional work.

root_cause_basis.observed_failure_pattern: In the first full v4.3 natural cycle, all five scheduler entries triggered but only AION created the required immutable liveness file. OMEGA, Macro, Flow, and DAEDALUS produced no runs directory. Repository write permission is proven by AION and the prior manual create_file canary.
root_cause_basis.corrective_principle: compact first action: scheduled prompt starts with the exact GitHub create_file action and arguments; no prose, analysis, discovery, read, search, provider call, or other tool action before persistence

steps: Do not emit prose or perform analysis before persistence.
Derive RUN_ID=<lane>-<UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ> from the invocation clock.

ABSOLUTE FIRST ACTION: invoke the connected GitHub create_file action directly against reppiks490/Icarus-engine on branch automation/omega-native-v2 at automation_intelligence/omega_stack_native_v2/<lane>/runs/<RUN_ID>.json.

The immutable receipt records RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LIVENESS_VERIFIED, WORK_PHASE_STATUS=PENDING, exact identity/protocol, nominal scheduled_for, started_at_utc, NET_NEW_DELTA=LIVENESS_PERSISTED_WORK_PENDING, DATA_GAPS=[], CONFLICTS=[], execution_authorized=false, verification_method=GITHUB_CREATE_FILE_RESPONSE, run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE.
Commit message is automation: <RUN_ID> liveness [skip ci].
A successful create_file response is durable liveness; do not read it back.
Only after liveness succeeds, perform at most one lane-specific bounded tool call.
Do not discover plugins or search for tools. If the named lane work action is unavailable, stop immediately; liveness remains valid.
If the work call returns promptly, create one immutable work receipt at <lane>/work/<RUN_ID>.json using the same RUN_ID.
Do not update the liveness receipt or latest.json.

immutable_append_policy.duplicate_path_behavior: Treat ALREADY_EXISTS as duplicate/collision evidence; do not retry or overwrite inside the same run.

scheduler_jitter.rule: Use nominal slot in scheduled_for. Jitter within tolerance is transport timing, not a persistence failure.

acceptance.liveness_single_run: One natural immutable run file is created successfully with exact identity and required values.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural v4.3 immutable liveness files with distinct RUN_IDs.
acceptance.work_completion: Track fraction of v4.3 liveness runs that also create a matching immutable work receipt.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five enabled authoritative lanes satisfy sustained_lane while scheduler registry remains exactly five enabled authoritative lanes.

legacy_artifacts.v3: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence.
legacy_artifacts.v4_2: Historical write-first latest.json receipts; useful evidence but not authoritative for v4.3 natural-run acceptance.

invariants: Only ChatGPT AI-plane natural runs may write <lane>/runs/ and use run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE.
The GitHub watchdog writes only under reconciliation/ and never writes natural runs/ or work/ receipts.
Missing, backlog, late-arrival, and recovery history is append-only; existing non-identical artifacts are never overwritten.
A watchdog or recovery artifact must never be promoted into a fabricated natural receipt.
A GitHub Actions failure remains visible as a failure and must not fall back silently to another credential.

natural_slot_attribution.rule: Capture started_at_utc, convert to America/Chicago, choose nearest lane-specific hourly boundary considering previous and next; tie chooses earlier.

phase2_recovery.prerequisite: Natural v4.3 liveness receipt for the current run has succeeded.
phase2_recovery.rule: After liveness, at most one bounded backlog lookup may select the oldest unresolved lane backlog item. Recovery may write one immutable reconciliation/recovered artifact with run_origin=BACKFILL_RECOVERY using only actually available historical evidence. It may never create or alter a natural receipt for the missed slot.
phase2_recovery.unresolved_definition: Backlog item exists and no corresponding recovered artifact exists; a late-arrival artifact means the natural historical event arrived and should not be reconstructed as missing work.
phase2_recovery.historical_truth_rule: Never represent a field as observed-at-slot unless its source provides valid historical point-in-time data.
